title: 第22章落脚黑镇洞悉阴谋第23章 夜探石楼邂逅镜中人

lines: 第22章落脚黑镇，洞悉阴谋
黑石镇的夜比黑水城更冷。
不是因为天气，是因为这座镇子已经变成了一座火药桶。
苏余和林霜策马进入镇子时，镇口告示栏上贴满了各路人马张贴的悬赏令和征调令。
其中最显眼的一张是青云宗三天前贴的，画着一个模糊的人脸，旁边写着“通缉令：此人于黑风岭盗取上古秘境秘宝，杀害青云宗执法队队长及多名弟子，悬赏灵石五千，死活不论”。
画像上的人脸与苏余只有五六分相似——悬赏令的画师只见过苏余一面，还是在兽潮围城的混乱中，能画出五六分已经是天赋异禀了。
苏余和林霜换了粗布衣袍，脸上抹了易容膏，混在逃难的废土流民中毫不起眼。
两人在镇子边缘找了一处废弃的马厩落脚。
马厩的屋顶塌了一半，地上铺着发霉的稻草，但这已是黑石镇最安全的地方——至少比客栈强，客栈里住满了各路人马的眼线。
刚安顿下来，镇口便传来一阵嘈杂的马蹄声。
苏余从马厩的破墙缝往外看去，只见一队身穿统一青色劲装的修士策马进入黑石镇。
他们的衣袍袖口绣着一座小巧的丹炉图案，丹炉下方有三道银色波纹——那是灵蛇商行的标志，北邙最大的商会势力，主营丹药、法器和情报买卖。
领头的是一名筑基中期的锦衣老者，花白胡须，腰间挂着一串储物袋，双目精光内敛。
他身后跟着数十名精悍修士，其中有两个人的气息连苏余也看不透。
“灵蛇商行的人也来了。”
林霜压低声音，“他们是冲着秘境宝物来的。
天机阁的消息发出来之后，整个北邙都疯了。
灵蛇商行肯定在镇子里布了眼线，任何可疑的人都会被盯上。”
苏余正要回答，镇口又响起一阵更沉重的马蹄声。
这次来的是一队穿赤红战甲的修士，战甲上刻满了火焰纹路，领头的是一名骑火鳞兽的中年男子，筑基后期，腰悬一柄赤红长剑，剑鞘上镶嵌着一颗拳头大的火行灵石。
他身后跟着数十名同样身穿火焰战甲的修士，队列整齐，杀气腾腾。
“烈阳宗。”
林霜的声音更低了，“北邙最强的宗门之一，宗主据说已是结丹期。
他们跟灵蛇商行是死对头，两家在黑山矿脉上打了十几年。
现在两家都派人来了黑石镇，这镇子怕是要炸。”
苏余没有说话。
他数了数镇子里已经出现的势力——青云宗、铁剑门、灵蛇商行、烈阳宗，还有那支天机阁放消息后就一直盘踞在镇子中央的散修联盟。
五方势力齐聚，黑石镇的街头巷尾到处都是互相提防的目光，偶尔有修士擦肩而过时手掌都按在法器上，空气中弥漫着一触即发的紧张气味。
就在这时，镇中央那栋最大的石楼顶上忽然亮起一道青色光柱。
光柱冲天而起，在空中炸开，化作一只巨大的青色竖眼图案——那是天机阁的传讯信号。
光柱持续了整整十息才缓缓消散，所有人都不约而同地抬头望向天空。
片刻后，一个穿白衣的青年男子从石楼中走出，站到镇中央的井台上，朗声开口。
他的修为不算高，只有炼气九层，但衣袍上绣着天机阁独有的天机眼纹路，脖子上挂着一枚传音玉符——他是天机阁的传信使。
“诸位道友，在下天机阁北邙分阁传信使周白，有一则重要消息通报。

Chapter 22 Settled in the dark town and gained insight into the conspiracy
The nights in Blackstone Town are colder than those in Blackwater City.
Not because of the weather, but because the town has turned into a powder keg.
When Su Yu and Lin Shuang rode into the town, the notice board at the entrance of the town was filled with reward orders and recruitment orders posted by people from all walks of life.
The most eye-catching one was posted by the Qingyun Sect three days ago, with a blurry human face and the words "Wanted Order: This person stole the ancient secret treasure in Heifeng Ridge, killed the captain of the Qingyun Sect's law enforcement team and many disciples, and offered a reward of 5,000 spiritual stones, regardless of his life or death."
The face in the portrait is only 50 or 60% similar to Su Yu - the painter who issued the reward has only met Su Yu once, and in the chaos of the beast siege, being able to draw 56% of it is already a gift.
Su Yu and Lin Shuang changed into coarse cloth robes and smeared disguise cream on their faces, blending inconspicuously among the refugees from the wasteland.
The two found an abandoned stable on the edge of the town.
The roof of the stable has collapsed in half, and the floor is covered with moldy straw, but it is the safest place in Blackstone Town - at least better than the inn, which is full of spies from all walks of life.
As soon as we settled down, there was a noisy sound of horse hooves coming from the entrance of the town.
Su Yu looked out from the broken wall of the stable and saw a group of monks wearing uniform blue uniforms riding their horses into Blackstone Town.
The cuffs of their robes were embroidered with a small alchemy furnace pattern, and there were three silver ripples below the alchemy furnace - that was the logo of Ling Snake Trading Company, the largest chamber of commerce in Beimang, which mainly engaged in the sale of elixirs, magical weapons and intelligence.
The leader was an old man in brocade clothes who was in the middle stage of foundation building. He had a gray beard, a string of storage bags hanging around his waist, and his eyes were bright and restrained.
Behind him were dozens of capable monks, two of whom had auras that even Su Yu couldn't see through.
"People from Spirit Snake Trading Company are here too."
Lin Shuang lowered her voice, "They came for the secret treasure.
After the news of Tianji Pavilion came out, the whole Beimang went crazy.
Spirit Snake Trading Company must have spies in the town, and anyone suspicious will be targeted. "
Just as Su Yu was about to answer, there was a heavier sound of horse hoofbeats at the entrance of the town.
This time, a group of monks came here wearing red armor. The armor was engraved with flame patterns. The leader was a middle-aged man riding a fire-scaled beast. In the late stage of foundation building, he had a long red sword hanging on his waist. The scabbard was inlaid with a fist-sized fire spirit stone.
Behind him were dozens of monks who were also wearing flame armor. They were in neat formation and full of murderous intent.
"Fire Yang Sect."
Lin Shuang's voice became even lower, "One of the strongest sects in Beimang, the sect leader is said to be in the elixir formation stage.
They were sworn enemies of the Spirit Snake Trading Company, and the two families had been at war over the Black Mountain Mine for more than ten years.
Now both families have sent people to Blackstone Town, and the town is afraid that it will explode. "
Su Yu said nothing.
He counted the forces that had appeared in the town - Qingyun Sect, Iron Sword Sect, Spirit Snake Trading Company, Lieyang Sect, and the loose cultivator alliance that had been entrenched in the center of the town since the Tianji Pavilion released the news.
Five forces gathered together, and the streets and alleys of Blackstone Town were full of wary glances. Occasionally, when a monk passed by, his palms were pressed on the magic weapon, and the air was filled with the smell of tension that was about to break out.
At this moment, a blue light pillar suddenly lit up on the top of the largest stone building in the center of the town.
The beam of light soared into the sky, exploded in the air, and turned into a huge blue vertical eye pattern - that was the message signal from Tianji Pavilion.
The beam of light lasted for ten breaths before slowly dissipating. Everyone looked up to the sky in unison.
After a while, a young man in white walked out of the stone building, stood on the well platform in the center of the town, and spoke loudly.
His cultivation level is not high, he is only at the ninth level of Qi Refining, but his robe is embroidered with Tianji Pavilion's unique Tianji Eye pattern, and a sound transmission jade talisman hangs around his neck - he is the messenger of Tianji Pavilion.
"Fellow Taoists, here is Zhou Bai, the messenger from Beimang Branch of Tianji Pavilion, who has important news to report.
